relationship.original_equation: Closing lease liability = opening liability + interest accretion - lease payments
relationship.locator: Paragraph 842-20-35-1(a), subsequent measurement of finance lease liability
relationship.translation_notes: All inputs are amounts in the same currency; interest and payments are nonnegative.

assumptions: Interest and payments relate to the same finance lease and reporting period.
No modification, reassessment, foreign exchange or other balance movement occurs.
limitations: The liability excludes payments not included in its measurement.
Lease principal and interest calculations themselves overlap the loan-family models excluded by the assignment.
Payments exceeding the opening liability plus accrued interest need separate allocation and are outside this simple lease-liability profile.
